title: Juicy Snappy Indian Vegetable Rasam
description: A flavorful and spicy Indian dish featuring green curry paste and coconut cream, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This ovo-vegetarian friendly rasam is a one-pot wonder.

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, potatoes, and green beans

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Stir in the green curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the coconut cream and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the sliced hard-boiled eggs and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
